changelog: Every config.lua option (300+) is now editable in-game from the new Configuration tab of /conf_acn_weathertime.
Changes apply live to all players and are saved automatically (SQL + KVP), no restart needed.
Smart schema-driven interface: options appear or hide depending on your choices, with search, per-field reset, export and import.
Coordinates (zones, Cayo protection...) are placed in-game with a laser raycast tool.
